newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Workers form club to buy Eletropaulo shrs.
newsitem.headline: Workers form club to buy Eletropaulo shrs.

text.p: Workers at Sao Paulo state power utility Eletropaulo said they have formed an investment club to buy company shares when the firm is privatized during the first half of 1998.

In a statement, electrical workers unions from Sao Paulo and Santos said they created Investeletro to allow 25,000 workers and retirees to take part in selloff and "take advantage of special conditions to buy company shares."

"The sale of Eletropaulo should take place in the first semester of next year and the deal is valued at 7.0 to 8.0 billion reais ($6.5-$7.4 billion), with at least 10 percent of shares reserved for company workers," the statement said.
Investeletro's main purpose is to secure as many shares for members, "with the greatest discount and best financing," it said.
The unions said they have hired local banks Banco Pactual and BCN to provide technical assistance and structure the financial operation of the club.
